origin.prompt: Instrumental classical chamber music for Tallyport, a welcoming harbour town in a fantasy role-playing game. Warm, lyrical violins and cellos lead, supported by rich viola harmonies and graceful flute, oboe and bassoon passages. A memorable, understated melody develops through elegant counterpoint and connected musical phrases. Gentle, flowing triple metre at a relaxed walking pace. Convey sea air, sunlight on wooden docks and quiet everyday activity. Lifelike acoustic instruments, expressive bowing, natural breathing, restrained dynamics and a clear, intimate concert-room recording. Keep the music comfortable beneath exploration and dialogue. Percussion-free: no drums, backbeat or driving rhythmic ostinato. No vocals or electronic instruments. Begin immediately with the established ensemble. Create a seamless repeating game loop whose final phrase flows naturally back into the opening, maintaining consistent instrumentation and volume. No introductory swell, closing flourish or fade-out, 76 BPM, loop, in 3/4 time.
